data.name: Jazal
data.gender_notes: Jazal is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'z-l-y', meaning 'to be fresh, new, or young'. This name is a reminder of the eternal youth and vitality that comes from living in accordance with Islamic values. The name Jazal carries the meaning “Youthful, fresh” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jazal usually hope their child will grow to embody youthful, fresh and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the freshness and vitality of youth, Jazal is a name that represents the ongoing renewal and rejuvenation of the soul.
data.etymology: Jazal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Youthful, fresh.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jazal total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
